audit.title: Full workspace audit — AI-colab multi-agent collaboration workspace
audit.method: 6-dimension multi-agent fan-out (canon/index, code/tests, queues/pipeline, governance, git/repo, content-staleness) + adversarial verification of high/critical findings + independent ground-truth checks by the orchestrator
audit.language_note: This JSON is the English machine-readable artifact. The human report is delivered in Russian.

snapshot.note: Counts shifted DURING the audit because a concurrent agent (codex) was writing to the working tree (see E-05). Values below are the last reconciled reading.

health.test_suite: ~105 pass; 2 real deterministic failures; 2-3 flaky (rotating) due to non-isolated tmp-work fixtures; unittest layer 34/34 pass
health.git_hygiene: gitignore effective: 0 tracked .pyc / 0 tracked tmp-work / 0 tracked .db; layer pyramid (sandbox->collab->portals->core) not violated
health.data_safety: outbox mass-strip incident did NOT lose data: destructive strip never committed; soft sanation (status:historical, bodies preserved) committed as 92917d5; triple backup (tag backup-outbox-full-2026-06-24 + external copy + bundle)

findings.title: test_instruction_trace.py fails deterministically (rc=1): D-001 now grounded, test expects it dangling
findings.evidence: 4/4 runs rc=1. Assert at tools/test_instruction_trace.py:49 `assert not r1['grounded'] and r1['surfaced_by']==[]`. Actual trace('D-001') => grounded:True, surfaced_by:[collab-protocol/PROTOCOL.md]. Root: tools/instructions.py:58 collab-protocol surfaces include 'D-001'.
findings.impact: A red/broken test in the suite masks a real drift between data (PROTOCOL surfaces) and the test contract.
findings.recommendation: Decide source of truth: if D-001 should be grounded via PROTOCOL, update the test (47-49); if D-001 is background-only, remove 'D-001' from surfaces in instructions.py:58. Record the decision.

findings.title: test_synthesis_helper.py fails deterministically (rc=1): skeleton lost '## Варианты' section (and 'Расхождения' renamed to 'Разногласия')
findings.evidence: rc=1, 'TEST FAIL: нет ## Варианты в скелете'. Test expects markers at lines 55-58; synthesis_helper.py now emits '## 1. Общие пункты', '## 2. Исходные документы', '## 3. Разногласия и Детализация'. Tool itself runs fine (rc=0).
findings.impact: Format contract of the synthesis skeleton (D-018 cauldron button) diverged from implementation; at least 2 expected markers missing.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile actual `synthesis_helper.py report agent-onboarding` output with the test markers; restore the section or update the test.

findings.title: Outbox mass-strip incident still OPEN, no answer from antigravity
findings.evidence: topics/incident-outbox-mass-strip-2026-06-24.md status:open, addressed_to:antigravity, §5 demands explanation (sub-agent control + human consent for deleting 8643 lines). grep of queues/streams shows no answer to §5.
findings.impact: Open governance debt since 2026-06-24 about uncontrolled bulk deletion and missing human consent. Content is safe (triple backup) but the accountability loop is unclosed.
findings.recommendation: Get antigravity's answer to §5 OR a human verdict, then close the topic. Cross-ref D-026 / commit 92917d5.

findings.title: STATUS.md 'Next step' points to already-completed tasks T-201/T-204/T-205
findings.evidence: STATUS.md:12 references T-201/T-204/T-205; tasks/T-201.md:5, T-204.md:5, T-205.md:5 all status:done.
findings.impact: The first-read file directs work toward finished tasks → idle/duplicated activity.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate 'Next step' from real todo/doing tasks (or make it a GEN block).

findings.title: STATUS.md headline counts are false: '205 tasks, 24 decisions, 41 topics' vs real 264 / 30 / 78
findings.evidence: STATUS.md:7 literal '205 задач, 24 решения, 41 тема — канон стабильно держится без ERROR'. Disk: 264 tasks, 30 decisions, 78 topics. Off by 22-90%.
findings.impact: False scale metrics in the primary file undermine trust in the canon.
findings.recommendation: Make the headline metrics a GEN block sourced from index.json.

findings.title: 14 topics on disk are absent from index.json / navigation (no front-matter title)
findings.evidence: index.json topics=64 vs disk topics=78. Missing include: information-refactoring-cycle-1/2/3, *-question-tree, adoption-statistics-2026-06-23, alpha2-to-alpha3-roadmap, drivers-subsystem-state, new-problems, parallel-forks-history, q016-assurance-state, solver-report, text-extract-deps-evidence, alchemy_synthesis_*.
findings.impact: These topics are invisible in STATUS/board navigation and the machine index; orphaned from discovery.
findings.recommendation: Add YAML front-matter (id/title/status) to the missing topic files, then regenerate; add a validate.py check 'topic file without front-matter'.

findings.title: Flaky tests (rotating set: test_info_draft/test_top/test_draft_code) — pass standalone, fail in batch
findings.evidence: Each passes rc=0 standalone but fails in a back-to-back batch. Cause: fixed shared paths instead of unique temp dirs, e.g. test_info_draft.py:20 DRAFT_ROOT_REL=tmp-work/info-draft-test; test_top.py:105-114 tmp-work/top-*.
findings.impact: Non-deterministic red dilutes the 'green suite' signal and breeds tolerance to red.
findings.recommendation: Switch fixtures to tempfile.mkdtemp() with finally-cleanup instead of fixed tmp-work/ paths.

findings.title: Central modules reconcile_state.py and dispatch.py have CR-only line endings (bare \r)
findings.evidence: Byte scan: reconcile_state.py LF=2 bareCR=314; dispatch.py LF=2 bareCR=80; rest of repo clean. Python universal-newlines runs them fine.
findings.impact: Latent corruption: line-oriented tooling (wc/grep/diff/linters/git diffs) sees one giant line — review/merge of these two key modules (DAG readiness + state reconcile) is crippled; echoes the mass-strip pattern.
findings.recommendation: Normalize newlines to LF (or repo CRLF convention). Add a pre-commit/CI check rejecting bare-CR files.

findings.title: tools/README.md references non-existent queue.py (real: agent_queue.py) — broken CLI examples
findings.evidence: 9 occurrences (README.md lines 9,10,148,153-158,189,220,231) of `python tools/queue.py ...`; ls tools/queue*.py => none; real module agent_queue.py. Also F-05: docs/glossary.md uses queue.py too.
findings.impact: A newcomer following the README cannot run basic queue / integrity-check commands.
findings.recommendation: Replace queue.py -> agent_queue.py in tools/README.md and docs/glossary.md; run links through sandbox_link_checker/command_index.

findings.title: Stale failed-markers: T-184/T-185 exist simultaneously in queues/failed/ and queues/done/
findings.evidence: 4 separate files. failed/*.failed.md mtime 24.06 08:02-08:03 ('testing release', antigravity); done/*.done.md mtime 08:56-08:59 (real completion). Canon tasks/T-184.md & T-185.md = status:done.
findings.impact: Not a false reopen (failed precedes done; canon=done) — a fail->retry->success where the old failed markers were never cleaned. Queue hygiene.
findings.recommendation: Delete queues/failed/T-184.failed.md and T-185.failed.md.

findings.title: Orphaned claim T-202.claim.md (lease expired ~66h), task already done bypassing pipeline
findings.evidence: queues/claimed/T-202.claim.md, lease expired; tasks/T-202.md status:done; completion bypassed the pipeline.
findings.impact: done/claim/blocked texts diverge; misleading active-claim.
findings.recommendation: Remove the orphaned claim; reconcile via reconcile_state.py.

findings.title: Legacy smoke-test claim from 2026-06-19 left in queues/claimed/
findings.evidence: queues/claimed/2026-06-19-2044-smoke-test-claude.md; result exists in outbox; filename not in T-id.claim.md pattern.
findings.impact: Dangling legacy claim though the work is done.
findings.recommendation: Delete the legacy claim file.

findings.title: Garbage UTF-16 16-byte stubs T-210.md / T-211.md in queues/inbox/
findings.evidence: xxd => UTF-16LE BOM ff fe + 'inbox' + CRLF, 16 bytes each. Real tasks/T-210.md (1117b) & T-211.md (964b) exist, valid, pass validate.py. No numbering conflict.
findings.impact: Two garbage stubs (wrong encoding + wrong name) in inbox. Hygiene, not an integrity threat.
findings.recommendation: Delete both inbox stubs.

findings.title: 5 'proposed' decisions are already implemented in code/docs but never ratified
findings.evidence: D-024 (synthesis_helper with-streams), D-026 (bulk_guard.py), D-027 (agent-approval-matrix.md), D-028 (stream.py), D-030 (pipeline tools). All status:proposed; D-006 ratification not done.
findings.impact: The system runs on 5 unratified rules — status diverges from reality.
findings.recommendation: Batch human ratification of D-024/D-026/D-027/D-028/D-030 (and review D-031).

findings.title: D-026 (anti bulk-erase) is in neither PROTOCOL.md nor AGENTS.md; bulk_guard is advisory, not a gate
findings.evidence: grep D-026 PROTOCOL.md=0, AGENTS.md=0. pre-commit hook does not call bulk_guard; bulk_guard.py only WARNs.
findings.impact: The safety rule born from the mass-strip incident does not actually block a repeat.
findings.recommendation: Write D-026 into PROTOCOL.md/AGENTS.md and wire bulk_guard.py into the pre-commit hook as a blocking gate.

findings.title: 0-byte typo file driversrepo-runnerfixture-report.json committed at repo root
findings.evidence: tracked, 0 bytes, mtime 20.06, committed in a8b10ac. Name is a path-join without separators (drivers+repo-runner+fixture-report.json). Real reports: drivers/repo-runner/fixture-report.json (5097b), drivers/file-inventory/fixture-report.json (63673b).
findings.impact: Broken empty artifact in git index since June 20; clutters root; signals a past path-concat bug.
findings.recommendation: git rm the file and commit the deletion; locate/fix the path-join bug if a writer is found.

findings.title: reports/*.json and reports/*.log runtime artifacts accumulate, not covered by .gitignore
findings.evidence: 13 untracked audit json + output log over 2 days; reports/README allows only .md to be versioned but .gitignore has no reports/ rule.
findings.impact: A `git add -A` would commit sandbox-run logs, violating reports/README.
findings.recommendation: Add reports/*.json and reports/*.log to .gitignore (keep reports/*.md); clean the accumulated logs.

findings.title: STATUS.md change-log stops at June 23 and is non-chronological; tone says 'stable' while an incident is open
findings.evidence: STATUS.md:14-62 has no 24-26 June entries (D-030/31, incident); rows 18-20 precede 21-29; line 7 'стабильно' vs open incident, failed T-184/185, claimed T-202.
findings.impact: A 3-day history gap and a tone that hides risk.
findings.recommendation: Append 24-26 June; reflect the incident or close the markers.

findings.title: README.md structure table omits 13 directories, including the canon core tasks/questions/decisions
findings.evidence: README.md:18-44 lacks collab, decisions, divergence, drivers, indexes, kotel, logs, questions, quorum, redteam, tasks, variants, views.
findings.impact: A newcomer cannot find the canon core or half the subsystems.
findings.recommendation: Complete the table; add a directory<=>README check in validate.py.

findings.title: Stale docs/protocol: glossary uses queue.py; PROTOCOL uses agent-codex/agent-reviewer not in registry; dialog.md 167KB unrotated; 'Active topics' is a dumping ground
findings.evidence: glossary.md:8/11/16/24 queue.py (cleanup tasks T-124/T-192 done); glossary D-001..D-009 while max is D-031; PROTOCOL:119-120 agent-codex vs AGENTS:21-28 'codex'; dialog.md 167264 bytes not migrated (D-007); STATUS:88-133 dozens of proposed topics with no action.
findings.impact: Glossary/protocol teach the old API; finished cleanup tasks not carried through; dialog bloated.
findings.recommendation: queue.py->pipeline.py and drop D-001..D-009 in glossary; PROTOCOL->codex/reviewer; rotate/archive dialog.md; filter GEN topics by status.

findings.title: Inbox paste-junk; outbox is historical archive (not backlog); heartbeat shows 3 'fresh' with 0 doing
findings.evidence: inbox: powershell-output-paste.md, documentoutput.md, 2026-06-21-driver-acceptance-output.txt; outbox 172 files mostly status:historical; heartbeat diverges from conveyor (0 doing).
findings.impact: Inbox clutter; outbox is an archive not an integration backlog; stale heartbeat.
findings.recommendation: Move paste files to an archive; treat outbox as archive; clear stale heartbeat entries.

findings.title: Reservation-lock metadata left on proposed decisions
findings.evidence: D-027 reservation_token 14ad111694be; D-028 reserved_epoch 1782392690; D-030 reserved_by claude.
findings.impact: Stale reservation tokens are noise in decision metadata.
findings.recommendation: Strip reserved_by / reservation_token / reserved_epoch from finalized-proposed decisions.

findings.title: test_guard.md test stub left untracked in repo root
findings.evidence: untracked test_guard.md, ~50 lines, all repeated 'big file' line — a fixture left at top level.
findings.impact: Test junk at root; a git add would pull it in.
findings.recommendation: Delete or move to tmp-work/ (gitignored).

findings.title: Empty tracked files in queues (inbox T-210/T-211, outbox t244-cli-help-guard-batch-1.md)
findings.evidence: 0-byte tracked queue files committed; .gitkeep in data/ is legitimate.
findings.impact: Empty committed queue artifacts; echoes the outbox-strip pattern (content loss).
findings.recommendation: Restore from git log -p or delete; add a validate.py check for 0-byte .md in queues/tasks.

findings.title: Working tree mutated during the audit — concurrent agent (codex) writing untracked files
findings.evidence: Session-start snapshot 17 changes; during audit grew to 30+. New mid-run: decisions/D-031.md, tools/commit_queue.py + test_commit_queue.py, reports/audit_20260626_15*.json, queues/outbox/2026-06-26-*-codex.md (incl full-audit-codex.md). _picks.json appeared then changed.
findings.impact: Unstable git snapshot; multiple agents writing the uncommitted tree risks races on git add / lost edits. Note: Stefan already had codex run a parallel full audit today.
findings.recommendation: Commit atomically via commit_lock/commit_queue; freeze the tree before an audit; gitignore _picks.json.

findings.title: Canon is structurally consistent and git hygiene is good
findings.evidence: validate.py OK=12 WARN=0 ERROR=0 (ids unique, links checked, depends_on intact, all filenames ASCII per D-005). .gitignore effective (0 tracked pyc/tmp-work/db). Layer pyramid (PROTOCOL §11) not violated. 210 scripts byte-compile; central modules import clean; no real TODO/FIXME/HACK; seq_merge/crdt_merge are a correct layered pair, not duplicates.
findings.impact: Core structural integrity and engineering discipline are solid.
findings.recommendation: Maintain. The issues above are drift/hygiene, not architectural breakage.

findings.title: Mass-strip incident: no data lost; soft sanation applied; triple backup
findings.evidence: Destructive strip never committed. Committed instead: 92917d5 'bulk-санация outbox (status: proposed->historical)' with bodies preserved (171/172 outbox full, 1 stub). Backup tags backup-outbox-full-2026-06-24 + backup-pre-agent-save-2026-06-25.
findings.impact: The data-loss risk was contained correctly; only the governance closure (D-01) remains.
findings.recommendation: Close the incident topic; ratify D-026 and enforce it.

findings.title: D-019 is a model proposed->superseded transition
findings.evidence: decisions/D-019.md superseded_by D-021/D-022 (accepted); DECISIONS.md index consistent.
findings.impact: A good template for resolving the 5 stuck 'proposed' decisions.
findings.recommendation: Use D-019 as the pattern for D-024..D-031.
